intro: Deoghar is best known for the Baidyanath temple, and much of the town's year runs around pilgrims. That shapes who asks us for playground equipment here: hotels and dharamshalas with a family courtyard, temple trusts with an open garden, and schools in the town and nearby blocks. FunPlay Systems makes all of this equipment at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,530 km away, and sends it to Jharkhand by road.

A play area at a pilgrim hotel or trust garden sees short, heavy bursts of use. During the Shravan month the crowds swell, and dozens of children may use the same slide in one evening. For that kind of site we suggest compact pieces with few moving parts, such as a multi play system with slides and climbers on one frame. Send us a few photos and the size of your space, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Planning a play corner for a hotel or trust garden
sections.html:
Most hotel and dharamshala courtyards in Deoghar are paved, and stone or concrete is a hard surface for a fall. Lay rubber flooring under the equipment, which we can supply with the order. Keep the play corner away from the main entrance so parents can watch children without blocking the path. Summers here are very hot, so place slides and decks where a wall or tree gives shade in the afternoon.

For guest areas, a themed piece from Clown Capade or Forestia gives children something to remember. If you also want machines for adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Deoghar.

faq.q: Can you install playground equipment on a paved courtyard in Deoghar?
faq.a: Yes. On a firm paved base we usually use the self-standing method and add rubber flooring under the play zone. Where the ground is soft soil, we grout the posts instead.

faq.q: Is the equipment suitable for heavy use during festival crowds?
faq.a: Our frames are galvanised pipe and our plastic parts are roto-moulded, both covered by a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. For crowded sites we suggest fewer moving parts and a larger clear zone around each piece.

faq.q: Who installs the equipment in Deoghar?
faq.a: We dispatch it from Vasai by road. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India then sets it up, following the layout drawing you approved.

intro: Dewas sits on the Malwa plateau next to Indore, and its industrial areas have brought staff colonies, schools and new housing to the town. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment to these buyers from our factory in Vasai, about 520 km away. Every piece is designed and made in-house, then sent by road to Madhya Pradesh.

Many Dewas projects begin with a modest budget and a large open plot. A factory colony or a school does not need to fill the whole ground at once. We often plan the layout in two stages: a swing set, a slide and a see-saw now, with space kept free for a multi play system later. The layout drawing shows both stages, so the first pieces sit where they will still make sense when the rest arrives.

sections.h: Black soil and foundations in Dewas
sections.html:
Much of the Malwa region has black cotton soil, which swells when it is wet and cracks as it dries. Posts set straight into this soil can tilt after a few monsoons. For open ground we suggest grouting the equipment on a proper concrete base, or laying a firm sub-base under a self-standing installation. Tell us about the soil on your site, or send a photo of a dug pit, and we will plan the foundation with you.

Plans for a staff colony often include adults too. See our outdoor gym equipment in Dewas, or browse individual playground equipment for a first stage.

faq.q: Can we buy playground equipment in stages?
faq.a: Yes. We can draw the full layout first and supply part of it now. The remaining pieces can be ordered later and placed in the spaces already marked on the drawing.

faq.q: Do you supply schools and factory colonies around Dewas and Indore?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai to sites across Madhya Pradesh and install the equipment through our own team or a local dealer.

faq.q: How do you install equipment on black cotton soil?
faq.a: We usually grout the posts on a concrete base so that movement in the soil does not tilt them. On a firm paved area, a self-standing installation may be enough.

intro: Dhanbad's coal belt brings a particular problem for anything left outdoors: fine black dust that settles on every surface. We keep that in mind when we suggest playground equipment for schools, mining townships and housing colonies here. FunPlay Systems builds every piece at our factory in Vasai, about 1,480 km from Dhanbad, and sends it to Jharkhand by road.

Roto-moulded plastic has a smooth, non-porous surface, so dust can be hosed or wiped off without scrubbing. Galvanised steel frames stand up to the humid monsoon months that follow the dry, dusty summer. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, and for dusty sites some buyers prefer deeper colours that look clean for longer between washes. Tell us the site size and age group, and we will send a layout with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: A simple maintenance routine for dusty sites
sections.html:
A play area in a coal township needs a short routine more than special equipment. Hose down slides and decks once a week in the dry months, since grit on a slide makes it slower and wears the surface. Check that drain holes in platforms are clear before the monsoon, and sweep rubber flooring so dust does not pack into it. Our after-sales team can guide your staff, and the 3-year warranty on pipes and roto-moulded parts applies when the equipment is maintained as per our instructions.

For township parks, a Play Lands multi play station suits large groups. Also see our outdoor gym equipment in Dhanbad.

faq.q: How should we clean playground equipment in a dusty mining area?
faq.a: Rinse plastic parts and slides with water and a soft cloth, and avoid harsh scrubbing pads. Regular washing keeps the surface smooth and stops grit from wearing the slide bed.

faq.q: Do you supply mining townships and colonies near Dhanbad?
faq.a: Yes. We supply townships, schools and residential colonies across Jharkhand, delivering from Vasai by road and installing with our own team or a dealer in the region.

faq.q: Which surface works best under equipment in Dhanbad?
faq.a: Rubber flooring is easier to keep clean than sand or loose soil, both of which hold coal dust. It also cushions falls and drains well during the monsoon.

intro: Dharmavaram is known across South India for its silk sarees, and it lies in one of the driest parts of Andhra Pradesh. Long, hot summers and low rainfall mean that sun, more than rain, decides how long outdoor equipment lasts here. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for schools, societies and parks at our factory in Vasai, about 750 km away, and delivers it by road.

In strong sun, a metal slide becomes too hot to touch by noon, and cheap plastic fades and turns brittle. Our slides and decks are roto-moulded and our frames are galvanised, which suits a dry climate well. We still advise shade over slides and platforms, from trees, a building or a separate shade structure. A school can also plan play periods for the cooler morning hours, and keep the afternoon for indoor activities.

sections.h: Shade and layout for a dry, sunny site
sections.html:
Before you fix the layout, watch where the shadows fall between eleven and four on a summer day. Place slides so they face north or east where possible, since a slide facing the afternoon sun heats up fastest. Keep swings in the open and climbers under partial shade. Leave a clear safe play area around each piece, which we mark on the layout drawing. Once you approve it, we manufacture the pieces at Vasai and dispatch them to your site.

For small schools, a compact unit from our Play Lands range covers several activities on one frame. See also our page on playground equipment in Anantapur.

faq.q: Will roto-moulded slides fade in the Dharmavaram sun?
faq.a: All outdoor plastics weather over time, but roto-moulded parts keep their colour much longer than painted metal. Shade over slides slows fading and keeps the surface cooler for children.

faq.q: Can you supply a small school in Dharmavaram?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the size of the play space and the age group. We will suggest a few pieces that fit and draw the safe play area before you place an order.

faq.q: How is the equipment delivered to Dharmavaram?
faq.a: We pack the equipment at our Vasai factory and send it by road to Andhra Pradesh. Our installation team or a dealer then installs it on your site.

intro: At about 260 km from our Vasai factory, Dhule is one of the closer district towns we supply in Maharashtra. The equipment travels by road through north Maharashtra, and our installation team or a local dealer sets it up on site. FunPlay Systems has designed and manufactured playground equipment since 2002 for schools, housing societies and municipal gardens.

Khandesh summers are long and very hot, and the monsoon here is shorter than on the coast. Equipment in Dhule has to cope with months of dry heat. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded plastic suit these conditions, and both carry our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Our design team also builds Funplay Originals, play structures inspired by Indian games, which give a school something different from the usual slide and swing.

sections.h: Planning for mixed age groups in a Dhule school
sections.html:
A school ground in Dhule often serves children from nursery to class eight on the same equipment, and that rarely works well. Younger children need low slides, spring riders and small climbers, while older ones want height, nets and balance pieces. We suggest two separate zones with a clear walkway between them, so a group of older children does not run through the nursery area.

For the senior zone, look at the Khel Khud structures. For younger children, our spring riders are a simple start. You can also see one of our Maharashtra projects at Raymond, Thane.

faq.q: How do you separate equipment for small and older children?
faq.a: We mark two zones on the layout drawing, each with its own safe play area. Low pieces go in the junior zone and taller structures in the senior zone, with a walkway in between.

faq.q: Who installs playground equipment in Dhule?
faq.a: The equipment goes by road from Vasai, and our installation team or a local dealer installs it using the self-standing or grouting method that suits your ground.

faq.q: Can the colours match our school's branding?
faq.a: We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades and can customise designs on request. Tell us your school colours and we will suggest a combination that works outdoors.

intro: Dibrugarh, in Upper Assam, gets some of the heaviest rain we plan for anywhere in India. Tea estates, schools and housing colonies around the town ask us for equipment that can stand outdoors through months of wet weather. FunPlay Systems manufactures everything in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,410 km away, and sends each order to Assam by road.

On a site this far from the factory, careful planning matters more than speed. We go through the layout drawing and the packing list with you before dispatch, so you know exactly what is coming and where each piece will stand. A dealer in the Northeast or our own installation team then installs it. Ask about rubber flooring at the same stage, since sending it with the equipment avoids a second shipment.

sections.html:
The rains here start early and last for much of the year, and low ground near the Brahmaputra can flood. Raise the play area above the surrounding ground and give it a slope towards a drain. Grouted posts on a concrete base hold better in soft, saturated soil than posts set in earth. Galvanised pipe resists rust and roto-moulded plastic does not absorb water, so both suit a wet climate. Check bolts and spring riders after each monsoon, since springs and bearings need regular care.

For school and estate grounds, see our Play Lands multi play stations, and for adults, our outdoor gym equipment in Dibrugarh.

faq.q: Can you deliver playground equipment to Upper Assam?
faq.a: Yes. We send orders from our Vasai factory to Dibrugarh by road. Installation is done by our own team or by a dealer who serves the Northeast.

faq.q: What should a tea estate school consider for its playground?
faq.a: Plan a raised, well-drained base, choose galvanised and roto-moulded equipment, and keep the play zone clear of open drains and slopes. We can suggest pieces for the age groups in your school.

faq.q: Is wooden play equipment suitable for Dibrugarh?
faq.a: Our wooden and composite ranges need more care in a climate this wet. For most sites here we suggest galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic, which do not rot or soak up water.

intro: We have installed a resort playground in Dindigul, so this is a district we already know. It runs from hot plains around the town up into the Palani hills and Kodaikanal, and resorts, schools and housing projects across it ask for outdoor play areas. FunPlay Systems makes the equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,140 km away, and brings it to Tamil Nadu by road.

A resort usually wants a play area that looks good in photographs and keeps children busy while parents relax close by. A school wants pieces that take daily use by whole classes. We help both, starting from your site photos and ending with a layout drawing that marks the safe play area around each piece. Once you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture, dispatch and install.

sections.h: Planning a play area for a resort near Dindigul
sections.html:
On a resort site the play area is part of the view, so colour and placement matter as much as the equipment list. Keep it within sight of a seating area or restaurant, and well away from pools and parking. The plains stay hot for much of the year, while hill sites are cooler and wetter, so the shade plan and surface should follow where your property sits. You can read about our resort playground in Dindigul.

Themed sets from Castle Crest or our Nature Sparsh collection give resort guests a piece children will ask to return to.

faq.q: Have you worked in Dindigul before?
faq.a: Yes. We installed a resort playground in Dindigul. For a new site we still start from your photos and site size, since every resort layout is different.

faq.q: Which equipment suits a resort play area?
faq.a: Themed multi play systems work well because they combine slides, climbers and decks in one striking unit. We can match the colours to your property from more than 15 roto-moulded shades.

faq.q: Do you supply schools in Dindigul as well?
faq.a: Yes. Schools, housing societies and parks follow the same steps: share the site size and age group, approve the layout and quote, and we manufacture, dispatch and install the equipment.

intro: Dispur is the seat of the Assam government, and many open spaces here belong to government campuses, staff quarters and institutions. Buyers in these offices usually need clear paperwork before anything is ordered. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,080 km away, and we prepare our layout drawings with that approval step in mind. The equipment itself is designed and moulded in-house, so we can answer technical questions directly.

Each drawing shows the equipment we suggest, where it sits on your plot and the safe play area around it. It comes with an itemised quote, so a committee can see exactly what it is approving. Once you sign off, we manufacture at Vasai, send the order to Assam by road and install it through our own team or a dealer in the Northeast.

sections.h: Choosing equipment for a campus or staff colony
sections.html:
In a staff colony, children of every age tend to share one park. A single multi play station with slides, a climbing wall and a deck works for most of them, with a separate swing set placed away from the main walkway. Dispur shares Guwahati's humid climate and heavy monsoon, so plan drainage under the play area and choose rubber flooring over grass, which turns to mud in the rains.

See our Play Lands range for multi play stations, or our page on playground equipment in Guwahati.

faq.q: Can you provide a layout drawing for government approval?
faq.a: Yes. We prepare a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, along with an itemised quote. Your committee can review both before any order is placed.

faq.q: What warranty do you give on equipment for public campuses?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as instructed.

faq.q: Who handles after-sales service in Assam?
faq.a: Contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday. We arrange support through our team or a dealer in the region.

intro: Durg and Bhilai have grown into one urban area, with the steel township's sectors on one side and Durg's older town and newer colonies on the other. Schools, housing societies and parks across both ask us for outdoor play equipment. FunPlay Systems designs and makes it at our factory in Vasai, about 900 km away, and sends it to Chhattisgarh by road.

Central Chhattisgarh has very hot summers followed by a strong monsoon, so equipment here must handle dry heat and then steady rain. We build with galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic parts, and back them with a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. To get started, tell us the size of your ground and the classes or age groups who will use it. A few photos of the ground help us suggest equipment that fits the space you actually have.

sections.h: Picking the right surface for a Durg play area
sections.html:
The surface under the equipment matters as much as the equipment itself. Bare earth turns hard in May and muddy in July, and neither is kind to a child who falls. Rubber flooring gives an even, cushioned base through the year and is simple to sweep. We supply it along with the play equipment, so both arrive and go in together. If budget is tight, cover the fall zones under slides, swings and climbers first and extend the flooring later.

For nearby sites, see playground equipment in Bhilai and our outdoor gym equipment in Durg.

faq.q: Do you supply both Durg and Bhilai?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver to sites across Durg, Bhilai and the rest of Chhattisgarh by road from our Vasai factory, and install through our team or a local dealer.

faq.q: Can we lay rubber flooring only in some areas?
faq.a: Yes. Many buyers start with the fall zones under each piece and extend the flooring later. We mark these zones on the layout drawing so you know where to begin.

faq.q: Which equipment suits a large school in Durg?
faq.a: Usually a multi play system for the middle years, swings and see-saws for the youngest and climbers for older children. We suggest the mix based on how many children use the ground at once.

intro: Durgapur was planned as a steel and industrial city, and many of its township parks and school grounds were laid out decades ago. If your site still has old painted steel swings and slides, replacing them is a chance to plan the whole area again. FunPlay Systems supplies new playground equipment to Durgapur from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,560 km away, delivered by road.

Older parks often have pieces placed close together, with little room between a swing and the nearest path. We redraw the area with a proper safe play area around each piece and suggest what to keep, move or remove. Our in-house team designs and builds everything, from roto-moulded slides to galvanised frames. A dealer in eastern India or our own team then installs the new equipment.

sections.h: Replacing old play equipment in a township park
sections.html:
Start with a walk around the existing area. Note which pieces are rusted at the base, which have broken seats or chains, and where the ground has worn into hollows under the swings. Clear those pieces before the new ones arrive and check that nothing sharp is left in the ground, since old foundations are rarely in the right place for a new layout. Durgapur's monsoon is heavy, so fill and level the worn ground and lay rubber flooring before installation.

For large parks, see our Forestia and Robo Romp themed sets, or our page on playground equipment in Asansol.

faq.q: Can new equipment use our old foundations?
faq.a: Usually not, because the new layout and post positions are different. We plan fresh foundations, self-standing or grouted, based on the ground at your site. Old post holes should be filled and levelled first.

faq.q: Do you supply parks and schools in Durgapur?
faq.a: Yes. Parks, schools, housing societies and industrial townships in Durgapur can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a local dealer.

faq.q: How do we start a replacement project?
faq.a: Send us photos of the current play area, its measurements and the age group of the children. We will suggest new equipment and a layout with the safe play area marked.

intro: Eluru sits among the paddy fields and canals between the Godavari and Krishna deltas, close to Kolleru lake. The weather is hot and humid for most of the year, with heavy rain in the monsoon. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for schools, societies and parks in Eluru from our factory in Vasai, about 920 km away, and delivers it by road.

Many enquiries from towns like Eluru come from schools and small housing projects working with a modest budget. You do not need a large multi play system to give children a good play area. A swing, a slide and a see-saw or spring rider, placed well with enough space around them, cover most of what young children enjoy. We help you pick these individual pieces and place them on a layout drawing, then manufacture and dispatch them from Vasai.

sections.h: Getting the most from individual equipment
sections.html:
Individual pieces are easy to add one at a time and easy to fit around trees and buildings. Choose a 3 ft or 5 ft slide for children under eight, and give a swing set enough clear space in front and behind for the full swing. In Eluru's humid weather, galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats and slides hold up well. Grout the posts on open ground, since soft delta soil can shift after heavy rain. A strip of rubber flooring under the swings and at the foot of each slide takes most of the wear.

Browse our swings and 5 ft slides, or see playground equipment in Vijayawada.

faq.q: Can we start with just two or three pieces?
faq.a: Yes. Many schools start small and add pieces later. We plan the full layout first, so each new piece has its own safe play area when it arrives.

faq.q: Will the equipment handle Eluru's humid weather?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist rust and moisture well. Grouted foundations hold the equipment firmly in soft or wet soil through the monsoon.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Eluru?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Eluru by road and install it with our own team or a dealer who serves Andhra Pradesh.

intro: Erode's turmeric markets and textile trade have made it a town of family businesses, and many of our enquiries here come from people building something of their own. That might be a new private school, a housing layout or a marriage hall with a lawn. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for all of them at our factory in Vasai, about 1,030 km away, and delivers it to Tamil Nadu by road.

A new project gives you the chance to plan the play area properly from the start. Fix its position before the landscaping and paving are done, so the foundations go in with the rest of the civil work. We can share the layout drawing and the foundation points with your architect or contractor early on. That way the play area gets proper drainage and does not end up squeezed into whatever space is left.

sections.h: Heat, rain and materials in Erode
sections.html:
Erode is hot through most of the year, and a good share of its rain comes with the northeast monsoon. Roto-moulded slides and decks stay cooler to the touch than bare steel, and they do not rust. Galvanised pipe frames handle the wet months. Plan at least partial shade over slides that face west, and use rubber flooring rather than loose sand, which gets very hot in the sun.

Closer to the hills, we installed a resort playground in Dindigul. For a new school, look at our Funplay Originals designs.

faq.q: When should we plan the playground in a new building project?
faq.a: As early as possible, before paving and landscaping. We share the layout drawing so your contractor can prepare the foundations along with the rest of the civil work.

faq.q: Can you customise colours or designs for our school?
faq.a: Yes. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades and design customisation on request. Our in-house design team can adapt a structure to suit your theme.

faq.q: Have you supplied anywhere near Erode?
faq.a: Yes, we installed a resort playground in Dindigul, Tamil Nadu. We deliver across the state by road from our Vasai factory and install with our team or a dealer.
